name: XMAX Inc.
summary: XMAX, Inc. focuses on the creation, manufacturing, and promotion of contemporary household furniture. The company offers a wide array of products, including collections for living rooms, urban-style dining spaces, bedrooms, and their unique 'nova qwik' series. These items are sold under several brand names, specifically Nova LifeStyle, Diamond Sofa, and Nova Living. The firm was established in 1992 by Ya Ming Wong and Yuen Ching Ho, and its primary operations are based in Commerce, California.
